plan.title: test(vitest): full suite passes then process fails on unhandled onTaskUpdate worker timeouts (Windows)

narratives.Description: On native Windows, pnpm run test can report all tests passed and still exit non-zero due to unhandled vitest-worker onTaskUpdate timeouts. Tune pool/timeouts or fail policy so a green suite does not fail the process solely on RPC timeouts.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

On native Windows, `pnpm run test` / `task check` can report **all tests green** and still exit non-zero because Vitest records unhandled worker RPC errors:

```
Error: [vitest-worker]: Timeout calling "onTaskUpdate"
```

Observed during v0.77.0 release Phase 1 preflight on `master` (2026-07-14):

- Test Files: **629 passed** | 2 skipped
- Tests: **9129 passed** | 51 skipped
- Errors: **2** (`onTaskUpdate` timeouts)
- Duration ~99s; then `[ELIFECYCLE] Test failed` / `ts:check-lane` fails
- Same pattern on immediate retry — not a single-test assertion failure

Stack points at Vitest 3.2.6 RPC (`vitest/dist/chunks/rpc.*.js` `onTimeoutError`), not application code under test.

## Why it matters

- Blocks honest `task check` / release Step 5 preflight on Windows maintainers even when the suite is logically green
- Easy to misread as a real regression and burn release time
- May be load/RPC related (large parallel suite + coverage) rather than a flaky unit test

## Expected

- Either the worker RPC timeouts do not fail the process when all tests passed, or
- Pool/timeout/worker config is tuned so `task check` is deterministic on Windows, or
- A documented, gated workaround for release preflight that does not hide real failures

## Non-goals

- Skipping the suite
- Treating this as coverage-threshold failure (coverage still printed after the unhandled errors)

## Acceptance

- [ ] Repro notes (OS, Node, Vitest, `pnpm run test` vs `task check`) captured
- [ ] Root cause class identified (Vitest RPC timeout vs hung worker vs coverage reporter)
- [ ] Fix or durable mitigation so Windows `task check` does not fail solely on `onTaskUpdate` after a green suite
- [ ] Regression guard or known-flake doc pointer if mitigation is config-only

## Environment (repro)

- OS: Windows 10/11 native (not WSL)
- Repo: `deftai/directive` @ master during v0.77.0 cut prep
- Vitest: 3.2.6 (from lockfile / stack)

## Related

- Release skill Phase 1 uses `task check` when `task ci:local` is absent
narratives.UserStory: As a Windows maintainer, I want task check to pass when the suite is green, so that release Step 5 is not blocked by Vitest worker RPC timeouts.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Adjust vitest.config.ts pool/rpcTimeout/maxWorkers (or equivalent) so Windows coverage runs do not surface unhandled onTaskUpdate worker RPC timeouts after a green suite.
2. Add a focused regression note or harness assert in packages/ that documents the failure mode and verifies the configured timeout/pool settings remain present.
3. Re-run pnpm run test on Windows and confirm the process returns success when all tests pass, using the test report as evidence.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. Green suite exits zero on Windows
2. Config encodes the mitigation
3. Mitigation is guarded

items.title: Green suite exits zero on Windows

narrative.Acceptance: Given the full vitest suite on native Windows, when all tests pass, then the pnpm run test process returns exit code 0 and does not emit failing onTaskUpdate unhandled errors.
Given vitest.config.ts after the fix, when the config is loaded, then it shows the pool or timeout settings that prevent the worker RPC timeout failure mode.
Given the regression check or documented config contract, when those settings are removed, then a focused test fails or the contract rejects the config.
